###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_38
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_38 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_38_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_38_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_38
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_41
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_41 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_41_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_41_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_41
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_42
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_42 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_42 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_42_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_42_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_42_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_42 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_42 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_42_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_42
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_42
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_42
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_43
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_43 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_43_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_43_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_43
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_44
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_44 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_44 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_44_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_44_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_44_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_44 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_44 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_44_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_44
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_44
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_44
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_45_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_45_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_45_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_45_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_45_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_45

				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_46
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_46 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_46 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_46_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_46
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_46
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_46
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_46
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_46 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_46_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_46_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_46
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_48
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_48 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_48_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_48_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_48
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_49
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_49 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_49 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_49_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_49_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_49_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_49 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_49 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_49_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_49
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_49
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_49
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_50
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_50 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_50_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_50_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_50
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_51
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_51 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_51 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_51_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_51_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_51_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_51 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_51 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_51_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_51
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_51
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_51
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_52_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_52_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_52
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_53
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_53 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_53 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_53_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_53
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_53
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_53
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_2

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_53_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm

					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm

			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_55 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_55_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_55
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_55
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_55
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_55
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_55 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_55_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_55_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_55
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_56_1

					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_56
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_56

				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_56
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {

###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_57_2 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_1
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_57_2 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_2 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_1
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_57
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_57 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_57_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_57_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_57
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_58
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_58 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_58 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_58_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_58_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_58_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_58 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_58 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_58_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_58
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_58
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_58
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_59
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_59 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_59_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_59_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_59
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_60
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_60 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_60 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_60_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_60_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_60_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_60 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_60 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_60_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_60
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_60
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_60
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_62 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_62_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_62
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_62
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_62
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_62
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_62 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_62_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_62_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_62
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_64
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_64 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_64_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_64_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_64
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# adm_65 deleted due to hash conflict

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_66
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_66 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_66 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_66_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_66_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_66_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_66 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_66 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_66_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_66
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_66
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_66
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_67
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_67 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_67_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_67_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_67
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_68
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_68 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_68 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_68_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_68_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_68_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_68 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_68 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_68_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_68
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_68
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_68
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_70

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_70 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_70 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_70_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_70
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_70
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_70
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_70
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_70 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_70_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_70_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_70
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_72_1 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_1 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_72
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_72 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_72_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_72_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_72
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_73
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_73 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_73 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_73_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_73_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_73_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_73 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_73 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_73_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_73
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_73
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_73
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_74_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_74
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_74 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_74_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_74_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_74
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_75
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_75 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_75 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_75_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_75_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_75_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_75 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_75 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_75_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_75
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_75
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_75
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_76_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_76_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_76_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_76_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_76
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_77
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_77 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_77 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_77_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_77
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_77
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_77
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_77
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_77 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_77_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_77_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_77
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
