###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_79
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_79 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_79_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_79_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_79
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_80
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_80 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_80 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_80_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_80_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_80_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_80 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_80 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_80_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_80
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_80
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_80
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_81
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_81 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_81_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_81_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_81
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_82
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_82 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_82 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_82_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_82_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_82_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_82 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_82 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_82_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_82
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_82
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_82
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_83_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_83_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_83
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_84
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_84 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_84 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_84_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_84
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_84
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_84
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_84_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm

					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}

			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_86 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {

		}
	}

		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_86_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_86
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_86
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_86
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm

					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_86
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_86 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_86_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_86_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_86
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_87

				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list

					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_88
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_88 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_88_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_88_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_88
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_89
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_89 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_89 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_89_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_89_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_89_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_89 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_89 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_89_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_89
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_89
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_89
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Deselect National Idea adm_90
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_90 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_90_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_90_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_90
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_91
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_91 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_91 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_91_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_91_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_91_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_91 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_91 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_91_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_91
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_91
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_91
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_93 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_93_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_93
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_93
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_93
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_93
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_93 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_93_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_93_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_93
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_95
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_95 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_95_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_95_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_95
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_96
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_96 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_96 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_96_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_96_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_96_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_96 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_96 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_96_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_96
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_96
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_96
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_97
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_97 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_97_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_97_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_97
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_98
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_98 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_98 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_98_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_98_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_98_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_98 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_98 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_98_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_98
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_98
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_98
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_100

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_100 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_100 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_100_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_100
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_100
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_100
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_100
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_100 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_100_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_100_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_100
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_102
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_102 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_102_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_102_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_102
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_103
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_103 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_103 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_103_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_103_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_103_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_103 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_103 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_103_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_103
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_103
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_103
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_innovation_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_104_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_3 
					years = -1 
				}
				remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_2
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_104
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_104 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_104_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_104_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_104
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_105
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_105 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_105 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_105_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_105_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_105_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_105 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_105 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_105_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_105
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_105
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_105
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_106_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_106_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_106_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_106
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_107
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_107 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_107 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_107_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_107
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_107
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_107
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_107
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_107 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_107_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_107_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_107
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_109
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_109 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_109_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_109_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_109
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_110
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_110 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_110 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_110_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_110_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_110_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_110 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_110 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_110_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_110
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_110
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_110
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_111
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_111 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_111_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_111_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_111
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_112
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_112 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_112 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_112_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_112_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_112_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_112 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_112 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_112_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_112
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_112
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_112
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_113_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_113_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_113
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_114
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_114 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_114 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_114_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_114
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_114
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_114
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_2

					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_114_3

		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_116_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_116
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_116
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_116
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_116
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_116 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_116_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_116_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_116
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_117
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_117 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_117 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_117_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_117_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_117_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_117 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_117 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_117_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_117
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_117
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_117
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
