###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_118
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_118 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_118_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_118_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_118
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_119
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_119 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_119 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_119_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_119_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_119_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_119 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_119 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_119_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_119
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_119
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_119
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_120_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_120_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_120
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_121
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_121 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_121 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_121_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_121_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_121_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_121 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_121 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_121_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_121
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_121
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_121
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_123 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_123_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_123
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_123
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_123
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_123
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_123 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_123_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_123_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_123
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_125
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_125 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_125_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_125_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_125
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_126
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_126 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_126 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_126_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_126_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_126_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_126 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_126 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_126_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_126
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_126
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_126
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_127
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_127 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_127_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_127_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_127
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_128
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_128 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_128 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_128_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_128_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_128_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_128 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_128 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_128_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_128
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_128
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_128
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_130
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_130 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_130 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_130_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_130
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_130
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_130
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_130
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_130 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_130_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_130_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_130
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_132
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_132 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_132_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_132_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_132
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_133
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_133 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_133 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_133_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_133_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_133_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_133 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_133 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_133_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_133
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_133
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_133
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_134_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = {

				}

			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_134
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_134 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_134_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_134_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_134
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_135
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_135 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_135 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_135_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_135_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_135_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_135 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_135 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_135_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_135
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_135
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_135
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_136_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_136_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_136_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_136

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_137
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_137 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_137 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_137_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_137
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_137
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_137
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_137
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_137 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_137_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_137_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_137
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_139
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_139 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_139_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_139_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_139
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_140
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_140 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_140 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_140_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_140_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_140_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_140 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_140 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_140_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_140
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_140
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_140
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_141
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_141 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_141_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_141_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_141
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_142
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_142 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_142 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_142_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_142_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_142_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_142 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_142 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_142_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_142
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_142
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_142
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_143_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_143_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_143_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_143_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_143_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_143_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_143

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_144
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_144 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_144 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_144_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_144
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_144
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_144
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_144 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {

				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}

					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_144_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm

					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm

					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_144_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_144

				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_146_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_146
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_146
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_146
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_146
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_146 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_146_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_146_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_146
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_147
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_147 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_147 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_147_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_147_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_147_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_147 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_147 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_147_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_147
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_147
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_147
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_148
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_148 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_148_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_148_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_148
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_149
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_149 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_149 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_149_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_149_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_149_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_149 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_149 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_149_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_149
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_149
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_149
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_150_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_150_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_150
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_151
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_151 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_151 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_151_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_151_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_151_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_151 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_151 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_151_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_151
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_151
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_151
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_153 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_153_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_153
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_153
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_153
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_153
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_153 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_153_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_153_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_153
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_155
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_155 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_155_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_155_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_155
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_156
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_156 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_156 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_156_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_156_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_156_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_156 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_156 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_156_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_156
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_156
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_156
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
