			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_157
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_157 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_157_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_157_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_157
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_158
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_158 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_158 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_158_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_158_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_158_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_158 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_158 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_158_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_158
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_158
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_158
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					subtract = 1
				}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_160
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_160 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_160 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_160_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_160
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_160
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_160
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_160
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_160 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_160_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_160_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_160
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_162
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_162 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_162_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_162_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_162
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_163
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_163 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_163 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_163_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_163_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_163_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_163 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_163 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_163_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_163
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_163
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_163
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_164_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {

		}
	}
	
	effect = {

				add_country_modifier = {

			}

			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {

					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_164
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_164 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_164_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_164_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_164
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_165
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_165 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_165 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_165_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_165_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_165_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_165 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_165 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_165_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_165
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_165
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_165
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_166_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_166_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_166_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_166
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_167
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_167 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_167 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_167_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_167
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_167
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_167
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_167
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_167 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_167_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_167_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_167
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_169
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_169 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_169_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_169_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_169
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_170
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_170 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_170 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_170_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_170_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_170_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_170 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_170 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_170_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_170
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_170
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_170
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_171
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_171 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_171_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_171_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_171
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_172
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_172 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_172 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_172_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_172_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_172_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_172 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_172 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_172_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_172
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_172
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_172
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_173_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_173_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_173_2
					change_variable = {

						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_173_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_173_3
					change_variable = {

					}

			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_173_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_174
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_174 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_174 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_174_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_174
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_174
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_174
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_2

		}

					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174

					}

					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_1

						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_174_3

					change_variable = {

					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm

				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_176_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_176
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_176
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_176
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_176
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_176 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_176_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_176_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_176
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_177
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_177 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_177 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_177_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_177_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_177_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_177 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_177 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_177_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_177
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_177
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_177
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_178
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_178 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_178_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_178_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_178
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_179
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_179 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_179 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_179_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_179_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_179_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_179 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_179 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_179_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_179
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_179
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_179
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_180_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_180_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_180
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_181
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_181 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_181 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_181_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_181_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_181_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_181 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_181 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_181_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_181
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_181
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_181
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_183 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_183_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_183
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_183
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_183
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_183
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_183 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_183_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_183_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_183
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_185
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_185 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_185_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_185_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_185
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_186
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_186 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_186 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_186_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_186_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_186_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_186 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_186 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_186_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_186
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_186
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_186
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_187
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_187 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_187_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_187_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_187
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_188
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_188 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_188 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_188_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_188_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_188_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_188 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_188 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_188_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_188
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_188
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_188
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_190
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_190 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_190 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_190_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_190
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_190
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_190
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_190
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_190 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_190_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_190_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_190
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_192
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_192 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_192_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_192_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_192
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_193
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_193 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_193 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_193_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_193_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_193_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_193 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_193 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_193_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_193
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_193
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_193
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_2
			var:iv2_var_innovation_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_194_3 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {

				add_country_modifier = {

			}

			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_innovation_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_innovation_points_adm
				change_variable = {

					add = iv2_innovation_cost_increase

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_194
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_194 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_194_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_194_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_194
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_195
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_195 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_195 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_195_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_195_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_195_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_195 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_195 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_195_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_195
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_195
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_195
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
