						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_196_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_196_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_196_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_196
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Select National Idea adm_197
###############################################################

iv2_ga_select_national_idea_adm_197 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36

	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	player_automated_category = governmentreform

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_1 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_2 }
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_3 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_no_points_for_nat_idea_adm
			var:iv2_var_progress_points_adm >= var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_not_reached_national_idea_limit
			var:iv2_var_current_national_idea_limit > var:iv2_var_national_idea_current
			}
			iv2_sct_dnat_idea_adm_197 = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { 
					modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197 
					years = -1 
				}
				set_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_197_1 
				set_variable = { 
					name = iv2_var_nat_adm_197
					value = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_197
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
						name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
						target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_197
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					add = 1
				}	
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_sub_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_progress_points_adm
					subtract = var:iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = iv2_tt_increase_points_adm
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
					add = iv2_progress_cost_increase
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

###############################################################
#### Deselect National Idea adm_197
###############################################################


iv2_ga_deselect_nat_idea_adm_197 = {
	type = owncountry	

	ai_tick = never

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_1
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_2
				has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_3
			}		
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {								
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = iv2_tt_give_up_nat_idea_adm
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_1
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_1
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_increase
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_2
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_2
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x2
					}
				}
				
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_3
					}
					remove_country_modifier = national_idea_modifier_adm_197_3
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_progress_cost_increase
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = iv2_var_national_idea_innovation_cost_adm
						subtract = iv2_innovation_cost_decrease_x3
					}
				}			
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				remove_variable = iv2_nat_idea_select_adm_197_1 
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = iv2_picked_national_ideas_list
					target = flag:iv2_picked_nat_idea_adm_197
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = iv2_var_national_idea_current
					subtract = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
